newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina says beats IMF June fiscal deficit goal.
newsitem.headline: Argentina says beats IMF June fiscal deficit goal.

text.p: Argentina posted a fiscal deficit in June of $70 million, beating by $90 million its half-year deficit goal agreed with the IMF, Treasury Secretary Pablo Guidotti said in an interview published Monday.
The June deficit compares with shortfalls of $127.5 million in May and $51 million in June last year.

"In the second half of the year, the goals (agreed with the International Monetary Fund) are equally hard to reach and they will also be met," Guidotti said in an interview with Ambito Financiero newspaper.
Argentina agreed with the IMF fiscal deficit goals of $1.4 billion in the first half, $600 million in the third quarter and $1.0 billion in the fourth quarter.
Taking into account the June figure given by Guidotti, the fiscal deficit in the first half would be about $1.31 billion, against $2.51 billion in the same period of 1996.
